_note: Names a skill must not take: a skill whose `name` collides with a built-in slash command is unreachable, because the built-in wins (R-17: `status` is the collision proven so far). `doctor` and `mcp` are built-ins too, which is why the product's sub-commands live under /snowarch rather than being skills of their own.
source: Claude Code 2.1.258 (Claude Code), enumerated on 2026-09-08 by asking the CLI itself in a headless session (`claude -p`) — NOT typed from memory. `claude --help` does not list slash commands and `/help` is interactive, so this is the CLI's own report of its commands rather than a parsed help dump; the distinction is recorded so a future maintainer re-seeds it the same way and knows what it is.
